t: Free Jupyter notebooks that teach data literacy and coding across school subjects.
steps: Open the Callysto site and browse the curriculum notebooks.
Choose one notebook that fits a lesson you already teach.
Open the hosted notebook in a browser or clone the notebooks from GitHub.
Run the teacher notebook from start to finish.
Ask IT to confirm that the hosted site is allowed.
Check whether students need accounts for the hosted version.
Join the free teacher training workshop.
